scope: Explicit content-to-structured-value fidelity assertions; preselected source families not used to implement rule-specific code; do not retrospectively adjust B9 scores.

families.bug: URL defanging modifies observed literal effectiveQuery
families.evidence: Actual upstream code with public synthetic samples, projected JSONRPC envelopes labeled as such
families.control: normal plain text and other safe values

families.bug: Live Markdown link formation in echoed caller query instead of literal value
families.evidence: Actual upstream component with synthetic echo, projected JSONRPC envelopes

families.bug: linebreak and empty/null distinction lost through table rendering
families.evidence: Actual upstream renderer and synthetic table; cannot claim full server wire

criteria.causal: Actual before/official-fix result must differ according to published defect and normal controls survive.
criteria.detection: Frozen analyzer code must emit relevant fidelity mismatch on old and not fixed. Unverified cases remain in selected denominator.
criteria.strictness: No post-run rule changes under frozen name. Missing or unexecuted source evidence counts as UNVERIFIED rather than hit.
